title: The Midnight Dial

beats.text: This is a work of fiction. Elias kept his smartphone in a locked drawer, yet every morning, the call log showed a three-minute conversation at 3:14 AM.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a vintage wooden drawer with a modern smartphone inside, dark shadows, cinematic lighting

beats.text: He never heard the chime, only the heavy, unearned exhaustion of a man who had been talking for hours. 'The connection is established,' he whispered.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome shot of a tired man sitting on the edge of a bed, head in hands, thick fog rolling across the floor

beats.text: On November 23, 2026, he finally wore noise-canceling headphones set to trigger a piercing siren at the slightest vibration of the nightstand.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of noise-canceling headphones on a dark bedside table, slow camera drift

beats.text: When the phone buzzed against the wood, the alarm jolted him upright into the dark. He snatched the device, pressing it to his ear.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome wide shot of a man sitting up suddenly in bed, clutching a glowing phone in a dark room

beats.text: A dry, familiar voice on the other end spoke with his own slow cadence. 'The connection is established,' the voice said softly.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome extreme close up of a man's ear and the glowing screen of a smartphone, blurry background

beats.text: 'Now please, for our sake, stop trying to wake up.' Elias looked at the screen; the incoming call was coming from his own number.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a smartphone screen showing the user's own contact name under 'Incoming Call', dark background

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
